title: Coast Guard medevacs Canadian sailor in Puget Sound
description: Coast Guard aircrew members aboard an MH-65 Dolphin helicopter from Air Station Port Angeles hoist an injured man from the 181-foot Royal Canadian Navy Ship HMCS Nanaimo, while it's transiting in the northern section of Admiralty Inlet, Puget Sound, Wash., Nov. 15, 2019. The sailor had reportedly sustained a head injury after suffering a fall and was transported to a Seattle Hospital for care. (U.S. Coast Guard video courtesy of Air Station Port Angeles)
